loss_taxonomy.methodology: Classified from closedDeck's real score/archetype/entryPremium/peakPremium/exitPnlPct/closedReason. BAD-ENTRY = marginal score (<35) and/or near-zero MFE before stopping (thesis never had real legs). BAD-EXIT = real double-digit MFE (>=14%) that fully round-tripped to a steep stop under a policy with zero intermediate protection below +100%. CLEAN STOP-OUT = moderate/high score, some real MFE, genuine reversal, exit policy correctly had nothing to fire yet. VARIANCE = high score, thin MFE, single-session violent reversal — hard to fault entry or exit specifically. 3+ same-bucket instances before calling it systemic (noise discipline).
